purpose: Remove metric, control-generation, and known-gap degrees of freedom before any H003 Edge Falsification V0 result is produced.
precedence: This file narrows ambiguous implementation details in the parent preregistration. It may not weaken any parent failure gate, add a strategy variant, change H003 parameters, or reinterpret prior negative evidence.

return_accounting.strategy_bar_return: r_t = close[t+1] / close[t] - 1; held_t = position[t]; change_t = abs(position[t+1] - position[t]); net_t = held_t * r_t - change_t * (fee_bps + slippage_bps) / 10000
return_accounting.annualized_return: expm1(log1p(net_cumulative_return) / years), where years = number_of_net_returns / 8760; undefined if terminal equity <= 0
return_accounting.annualized_sharpe: mean(net_t) / population_stddev(net_t, ddof=0) * sqrt(8760), risk-free rate zero; undefined if stddev is zero
return_accounting.maximum_drawdown: minimum over equity_t / running_peak_t - 1, with starting equity 1.0 and equity_t = cumulative product of 1 + net_t
return_accounting.calmar_ratio: annualized_return / abs(maximum_drawdown); undefined if annualized_return is undefined or maximum_drawdown equals zero
return_accounting.undefined_primary_metric_policy: Any undefined H003 Sharpe or Calmar required by a decision gate causes BLOCKED_BY_INPUT_OR_INTEGRITY, never favorable imputation.

SOL_BUY_AND_HOLD.fees_and_slippage: ZERO for the primary historical benchmark, matching the existing QntyLab buy_and_hold_return convention; this intentionally makes the benchmark harder to beat.
SOL_BUY_AND_HOLD.return_path: close[t+1] / close[t] - 1 on exactly the same admitted return intervals as H003
SOL_BUY_AND_HOLD.metric_formulas: same Sharpe, drawdown, annualized-return and Calmar formulas as H003

CASH.role: reference only; undefined Sharpe/Calmar are not success evidence

algorithm: Use the exact binary H003 held-position sequence on admitted return intervals within one historical decision block.
Run-length encode the sequence into maximal alternating state runs (state in {0,1}, positive integer length).
Separate run lengths by state while preserving the block's original starting state and number of runs of each state.
For each seed, independently permute the state-0 run-length list and state-1 run-length list with the declared PCG64 generator.
Reconstruct an alternating state sequence beginning with the original starting state by consuming the corresponding permuted run lengths.

The reconstructed sequence must have exactly the original length, exactly the original number of long intervals, exactly the original number of flat intervals, and the same multiset of long-run and flat-run lengths; otherwise fail closed.
Apply the same cost mode to transitions in the reconstructed sequence.
EXPOSURE_MATCHED_RANDOM_TIMING.comparison_statistic: median metric across the 10 frozen seeds

algorithm: Use fixed non-overlapping 168-hour blocks of the H003 held-position sequence, starting at the first admitted return interval of the evaluated decision block.
Leave a final partial block, if any, fixed at the end.
For each seed, permute only the full 168-hour blocks with the declared PCG64 generator and then append the unchanged partial tail.
No return series is shuffled; only the timing-position blocks are permuted.
Apply the same cost mode after reconstruction.
BLOCK_SHUFFLED_H003_SIGNAL.comparison_statistic: median metric across the 10 frozen seeds

H003_SIGNAL_DELAYED_24H.algorithm: Set held_control[t] = 0 for the first 24 admitted return intervals and held_control[t] = h003_held[t-24] thereafter; apply the same cost mode.

gap_and_input_semantics.global_rule: Never create an ordinary missing candle and never compute a return across a timestamp gap.

BLOCK_2021.procedure: Split 2021 at every manifest-declared gap into maximal contiguous hourly segments. Each segment is an independent qntylab.strategy_test run under the exact H003 variant and cost mode. The strategy state resets at each segment boundary; no pre-gap state is carried across missing time. Concatenate only the admitted per-segment net-return paths in chronological order for block-level risk metrics. Do not charge or infer a transition across a gap.
BLOCK_2021.interpretation: Conservative diagnostic of 2021 under official gap-reject semantics; no ordinary gap normalization is authorized.
BLOCK_2021.minimum_segment_rule: A segment with fewer than 193 close observations contributes no H003 decision metric and is excluded symmetrically from H003 and benchmark return-path aggregation; exclusion count must be reported.

OTHER_BLOCKS.policy: Exact authoritative raw input; qntylab.strategy_test must reject any unexpected gap. Any newly discovered gap blocks that block and cannot be normalized after result inspection.

aggregation.complete_historical_sample: Concatenate admitted chronological net-return paths from 2021 through the frozen 2026 endpoint, with no synthetic return at a gap or input-boundary join. Strategy and benchmark use exactly the same admitted market-return intervals. Position state resets to FLAT at every excluded-gap or separately materialized block boundary; no transition cost is invented across a boundary.
aggregation.block_metrics: Computed from each block's admitted net-return path with the frozen formulas above.

implementation_constraints: All H003 strategy result-producing runs must be created through qntylab.strategy_test.

A separate deterministic analysis module may derive Sharpe, Calmar and controls only from frozen input bytes plus strategy_test-bound strategy semantics; it must not call an alternative H003 evaluator.
The analysis implementation and focused tests must be committed before any V0 output is inspected.
No result may change these formulas, seeds, gap rules, controls or verdict gates.
